correctness.rationale: Direct argument: two adjacent fully monitored triangle columns propagate globally; successive occupied columns with weights a,b<=2 and directed gap d<a+b force such a pair in exhaustive cases d=1,2,3. Summing all cyclic gap inequalities yields n>=2|S| for any failed placement with >=2 occupied columns; the one-column n=3 exception is excluded separately. Alternating same-row sensors yield a stalled set of floor(n/2), proving equality. Standalone C++17 direct exhaustive checks n=3..7 and local checks up to n=13 passed; finite checks supplement an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem determines the exact natural failed-power-domination invariant for every length of the first thin rectangular torus not covered by 2023 square-torus results. Its cyclic weighted-gap obstruction and sharp stalled family show how a periodic boundary changes the guaranteed-monitoring threshold relative to known clique-path values, particularly at even lengths; it is not a routine numerical table or arbitrary finite slice. The precise graph family is motivated by a published toroidal-grid literature gap.
